findings: No non-exception gea::Value::box site occurs in the audited global application function definitions. The index emits two thrown Error carriers; the spectrum processing bodies emit none.

Generated gea_readOwnField and property-descriptor compatibility adapters explicitly box native fields/handles/functions. NativeFieldRead alternatives are also emitted. These adapter sites are retained explicitly here; this is not a blanket zero-boxing pass.

index.cpp includes Value-typed iterator compatibility records and a NumericDictionary<Value> sidecar. The module Array.from({length:6},...) call constructs the native length record and calls fromLength with its double length; no Value payload is produced there.

spectrum.cpp FFT processing reads/writes native TypedArray<float>/TypedArray<uint16_t>, keeps float32 arithmetic, and posts a native ArrayBuffer with a tagged-union transfer list. No boxed Value appears in those processing/publication bodies.

The source audit identifies no ordinary typed application value lowered to a boxed carrier. It does not prove dynamic reflection adapters are never executed, and does not audit hidden runtime implementations behind every native host call.

anchors.finding: Ordinary AudioWorklet INFO stats report no more frequently than every two seconds; separate from disabled display performance/FPS flags.

anchors.finding: Info output, formatting and USB/console transport overhead remain active under retained INFO configuration.
Audio process wall timing uses timer reads and per-quantum counters under ESP_PLATFORM.
Ordinary audio runtime calls the stats reporter.
Task CPU accounting is unavailable when FreeRTOS trace/runtime stats are disabled; wall timings are not CPU utilization.

audio_info_overhead.disclosure: Ordinary FFT worklet timer/counter/INFO-log overhead remains part of production and diagnostic behavior. No fixed penalty is estimated; cpu_us=-1 is unavailable task CPU evidence.
